in_marathi.name: Akshya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akshya refers to the divine mark or symbol that cannot be destroyed or altered. It represents the unstoppable and inevitable force of destiny or dharma.
